# goBILDA 2mm GT2 timing belts

From https://www.gobilda.com/2mm-gt2-timing-belts/ (fetched 2026-10-08). All are 6mm wide, 2mm pitch, so a belt's
pitch length is twice its tooth count.

Continuous loops ("2mm Pitch GT2 Timing Belt (6mm Width, <length>mm Pitch Length, <teeth> Tooth)"):

Cut to length: 5 meters, 6mm wide, SKU 3426-0006-0005.

Pulleys for these belts are goBILDA's 3421 and 3422 series (like GB-3421-0014-0060, a 60 tooth two-piece pulley).
